integrity: An algebraic proof, complete rowspace and dual, fourteen direct-multiplication tests, and the precise published special-case comparison are provided; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative chain rings of nilpotency index at least three; simple graph on nonzero nonunits; prime-field adjacency matrix. No assertion for length two, non-chain rings, Laplacian codes or complete weight enumerators; finite computations corroborate rather than prove the uniform result.
title: Adjacency codes of finite chain-ring zero-divisor graphs: uniform dimension, hull and weight-one spectrum
